title: Capability request
description: A demand-capture placeholder for a capability the catalog does NOT yet provide. It is a typed empty slot (NOT an eighth primitive): typed to the component `target_type` it will eventually become, carried at maturity `abstract`, and never tenant-visible as a component. It leaves this state only by promotion — minting a real component at lifecycle `experimental` — after passing the two-axis lift gate (lift AND durability). Fulfilled by a premium agent build or a community build; a working+shared community build earns credits. Operational object: like review-ticket / object-factory-job it is NOT a catalog component type and is not in validate.py TYPE_TO_SCHEMA.

capability_request_id.description: Stable id. Long generated ids must carry a content-hash suffix (see docs/codex/no-magic-values.md — never truncation alone).

description.description: What capability is needed and what the user was trying to accomplish — the unmet need in the user's words.

target_type.description: The component type this request will become once built. The primitive is DERIVED from this via scripts/primitives (label_for_type) — not stored separately, to avoid type/primitive drift.

maturity.description: Always `abstract` while this object is open (see vocabularies/lifecycle.yaml). Promotion mints the component at `experimental` and closes this request; it is never `abstract` and a component at the same time.

status.description: requested → triaged → researching → building → built → verifying → promoted (terminal success) | rejected | duplicate (terminal).

fulfillment.description: Who builds it. agent_build = premium hosted build-on-demand; community = a contributor builds and shares (reward-eligible).

requested_by.description: Tenant/user id of the requester (demand signal). Do not store PII — an opaque id only.

demand_count.description: How many distinct requesters/queries hit this same gap — demand aggregation for prioritization.

seed_repos.description: Candidate source repos (repo_full_name into data/repo-catalog/) the build-agent researches and may wrap. Honors the gate on those rows — never wrap a `reference-only · do-not-ingest` repo.

research_area_id.description: Link to a data/research-queue/areas.jsonl area, if this gap was surfaced/ranked there.

lift_gate.description: The two-axis admission gate. A request promotes only when status=passed (pipeline lifts over the bare model AND the lift is structurally durable). See scripts/eval/durable_gap_harness.py.

lift_reason.description: lift_reason code — single source: scripts/eval/reason_codes.py (do not re-enumerate here).

build_job_id.description: Link to the object-factory-job that performs the build (see schemas/object-factory-job.schema.json).

promotion_decision_id.description: Link to the promotion-decision that admitted (or refused) the built component.

promoted_component_id.description: Set once promoted — the id of the real component this request became.

reward.description: Contributor incentive for a community build. Credits are awarded only when the build WORKS (passes the lift gate) AND is shared.

condition.description: The only reward condition: the shared component passed the lift gate.
